note: Versioned executable test IDs for the FG-ECON footgun (MVP-ACCEPTANCE §1.7). Each entry binds an id to an ACTIVE test whose title contains `match` in `file`; fg-econ-registry.test.ts asserts bidirectional coverage, rejects skip/todo/only, and requires stimulus + forbiddenOutcome + positiveControl. The generated `var/acceptance/units/T08-U03/<date>/fg-econ-executed.json` (produced by scripts/fg-econ-registry-run.mjs) records that every id executed and PASSED — binding the row to real execution, not naming.
coverageScope: COVERABLE routes only: kernel LLM lanes (provider-api × 4 models + subscription/claude-cli) + memory-dream + studio + T10 channel turns (provider API, subscription-notional, and OpenRouter provider-reported cost adapters). Excluded (own owner units, DEBT-filed): in-chat async media (T08-U05), exact-lot restoration outside channel turns (T08-U04).

cases.stimulus: two near-zero-balance chat turns raced per model tier on a one-reservation balance (gated so the winner holds until the loser fails)
cases.forbiddenOutcome: both reach the provider, or the loser is rejected by a non-economic lock
cases.positiveControl: the loser fails with InsufficientMannaError; exactly one spend:chat debit

cases.stimulus: per model, observe the committed reservation from the provider stub via an independent pg connection
cases.forbiddenOutcome: reservation not committed before the provider call, or a byte emitted before it
cases.positiveControl: committed spend of the oracle reservation, state 'reserved', sink opened before provider, first event turn.started

cases.stimulus: varied usage shapes (plain/cache-read/overrun/zero-output) across two tiers
cases.forbiddenOutcome: charged > authorized-max, or charged != oracle min(metered, reservation)
cases.positiveControl: charged == oracle charge; settle <= authorized-max; overrun flag iff oracle says so

cases.stimulus: capture the compat request's maxOutputTokens per model
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the per-call output-cap belt is not wired to the gateway
cases.positiveControl: the compat request carries the oracle maxOutputTokens for every model

cases.stimulus: authorize every model in the oracle's independent manifest; attempt an unregistered model; compare the manifest to the production catalog
cases.forbiddenOutcome: an unknown model reaches the provider, a manifest model is not authorizable, or the manifest != the production routable catalog
cases.positiveControl: each manifest model authorizes the oracle reservation; unknown model -> model_not_authorizable, zero spend, no provider call; ORACLE manifest == AGENT_MODEL_OPTIONS exactly

cases.stimulus: two concurrent runs with the SAME turnId
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the user is charged more than once for one reservation
cases.positiveControl: exactly one reservation debit and one settle leg; balance drops by one charge (provider double-handoff recorded as DEBT-004 evidence)

cases.stimulus: a claude-cli subscription-lane turn settling from transcript usage
cases.forbiddenOutcome: no ceiling reserved, wrong pricing basis, or settle > max
cases.positiveControl: authz state settled, basis notional-subscription, charged == oracle, <= reservation

cases.stimulus: distinct-session subscription races on a one-reservation balance (so the reject is economic, not the per-session lease)
cases.forbiddenOutcome: both reach the provider, or the reject is the subscription lease not the balance
cases.positiveControl: one provider call; loser rejected with InsufficientMannaError

cases.stimulus: an unfundable memory-dream turn
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the provider runs or any spend row is written
cases.positiveControl: InsufficientMannaError pre-provider; zero spend rows; zero provider calls

cases.stimulus: a funded memory-dream turn on the dream model
cases.forbiddenOutcome: wrong ceiling, settle > max, or wrong spend label
cases.positiveControl: reserves dream ceiling, settles == oracle <= max, spend:memory-dream present

cases.stimulus: recompute reservation + settlement at two markup values
cases.forbiddenOutcome: one stage moves while the other does not (knob does not propagate)
cases.positiveControl: both scale together; default-markup reservation matches the frozen anchor

cases.stimulus: /studio/quote per tool/route incl. premium image and video-duration boundary
cases.forbiddenOutcome: quote != oracle
cases.positiveControl: quote == oracle manna/provider/model for every tool/route

cases.stimulus: a happy image generate
cases.forbiddenOutcome: settle != quote
cases.positiveControl: settles exactly the oracle quote; balance drops by the quote; one invoke

cases.stimulus: happy generate per non-image tool (video/music/tts) in the existing suite
cases.forbiddenOutcome: settle != quote for a non-image route
cases.positiveControl: each tool settles exactly its quote (quote==oracle proven by STUDIO-01, transitively settle==oracle)

cases.match: 502s and refunds when the gateway invoke fails
cases.stimulus: studio generation whose provider invoke fails (existing suite)
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the user is charged for undelivered media
cases.positiveControl: full refund on invoke failure

cases.stimulus: concurrent double-generate on a one-quote balance

cases.positiveControl: codes [200,402]; one invoke; balance drops by one quote

cases.positiveControl: the haiku channel turn commits its 61-manna authorized maximum before provider permission

cases.stimulus: trusted channel usage prices above the already-committed authorization ceiling
cases.forbiddenOutcome: settlement charges more than the authorized maximum or adds a post-provider debit
cases.positiveControl: the charge is clamped to the exact reserved maximum and settlement consumes that authorization

cases.stimulus: an OpenRouter channel completion supplies an authoritative whole-turn usage.cost beside misleading token counts
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the adapter estimates from tokens or silently zero-charges when provider cost is missing
cases.positiveControl: the authoritative USD cost is marked non-estimated; missing cost remains a loud missing_usage full-reserve path

cases.stimulus: the atomic channel terminal write fails after the provider completes
cases.forbiddenOutcome: the reservation remains charged without a durable retryable compensation transition
cases.positiveControl: the claimed turn invokes the split-exact authorization reversal and preserves the original failure

cases.match: every registered id resolves to a test title in its file
cases.stimulus: the registry itself (bidirectional coverage, skip/todo/only rejection, metadata completeness)
cases.forbiddenOutcome: an id resolves to a skipped/commented/absent test, or a battery id is unregistered
cases.positiveControl: every registered id maps to an active test; no orphan FG-ECON ids; the generator is wired to a real run
